investigation.title: Remote Agent Pod Scheduling Failure: Exhausted kata.peerpods.io/vm Capacity Across All Available Nodes
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in the production-api environment because every pod submitted for remote agent creation was rejected by the Kubernetes scheduler with an Unschedulable verdict: 2 nodes reported Insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm capacity and the remaining 4 nodes did not match the pod's node affinity or selector. No evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was collected because the pod never left the Pending state and the agent was never provisioned.
investigation.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the remote-agents feature has exhausted the allocatable kata.peerpods.io/vm resource on the 2 nodes that carry that resource type. The 4 remaining nodes are ineligible due to node affinity or selector mismatch. With 0 of 6 nodes schedulable and preemption unable to free capacity (no lower-priority victims found), every remote-agent pod is stuck Unschedulable. This is a cluster-level infrastructure capacity constraint, not an eval infrastructure defect or a code regression. No user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence, so impact is scoped to the observability eval at this time.

No evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was collected because the pod never left the Pending state and the agent was never provisioned.
investigations.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the remote-agents feature has exhausted the allocatable kata.peerpods.io/vm resource on the 2 nodes that carry that resource type. The 4 remaining nodes are ineligible due to node affinity or selector mismatch. With 0 of 6 nodes schedulable and preemption unable to free capacity (no lower-priority victims found), every remote-agent pod is stuck Unschedulable. This is a cluster-level infrastructure capacity constraint, not an eval infrastructure defect or a code regression. No user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence, so impact is scoped to the observability eval at this time.

investigations.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the remote-agents feature (production-api environment) has exhausted its allocatable kata.peerpods.io/vm resource slots on the 2 nodes that carry that resource label. The snapshot served at eval time was 350 minutes old (evidence id: failed-check.evidence, failed-check.message), causing the snapshotAgeMinutes <= 300 assertion defined in infra/evals/status/check-expectations.json line 482 to fail.
